newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-CESARE MALDINI NAMED AS ITALY COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CESARE MALDINI NAMED AS ITALY COACH.

text.p: Cesare Maldini was appointed coach of Italy's national soccer team on Sunday, soccer federation president Luciano Nizzola announced.
Maldini, the popular under-21 coach, replaces Arrigo Sacchi who resigned two weeks ago to return to coaching his old club AC Milan.
"Cesare Maldini is the new coach of the national team," Nizzola said in statement, adding that Maldini would be officially presented at a news conference at Rome's Olympic Stadium on Monday.
The appointment was Nizzola's first act as soccer federation president after being elected on Saturday to replace Antonio Matarrese who was ousted several months ago.

Materrese's end came after Italy crashed out of Euro 96 in the first round and over widespread anger at his decision to renew Sacchi's contract until 1998. Sacchi resigned as the poor run continued with limp performances in World Cup qualifiers and a defeat to Bosnia in a friendly in Sarajevo.
